leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Mysterious Mew is the first monthly issue of the Pokémon Adventures manga to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the first three chapters of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

Pokémon Adventures: Mysterious Mew is the first monthly issue of the Pokémon Adventures manga to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the first three chapters of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later compiled into . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: A Glimpse of the Glow
Chapter 2: Bulbasaur, Come Home!
Chapter 3: The Secret of Kangaskhan

==Important events==
meets .

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Red's in PS001.
Red's "Saur" in PS002.

==Trivia==
In an advertisement in the Pokémon Origami book, also published by VIZ Media, this issue is depicted with a different cover, resembling the cover of the Japanese version of .
